# FlareColumnRow

`Flare.Components.FlareColumnRow`

One visual line inside a composite column - the way several fields of a record are stacked in a single cell instead of spread across columns. The fields declared in it are laid out left to right; the row itself renders nothing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Field columns laid out left-to-right in this composite row. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Captures any unmatched HTML attributes. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `CssClass` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Custom CSS class for the column/band header. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `Frozen` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Sticks this column to the left edge when the table scrolls horizontally. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `FrozenRight` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Sticks this column to the right edge when the table scrolls horizontally. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `Title` | `string` | `""` | Parameter |  | Header text displayed in the column/band heading, and the name the column is known by everywhere else - the export, the filter menu, the column picker, aggregates. Still required when TitleContent is set, because those places need text. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `TitleContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Markup painted in the heading instead of Title - a unit, an icon, a help affordance. Display only; Title keeps carrying the column's name. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
| `Width` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Fixed CSS width of the column. It is exact when every visible column declares a plain length such as 96px or 6rem: the header and the cells keep it, a label wider than its column is cut with an ellipsis, and cell content that does not wrap can overflow instead of widening the column. Columns without a Width share the rest of the grid width; when every visible column has one, the table keeps exactly their sum and the remaining grid width stays empty, so leave one column without a Width to fill the grid. A percentage or a CSS function is a share of the table rather than an exact width, and the grid keeps filling its container. Without a Width a column is never narrower than the narrowest its content can be: a header label (one line), a value without spaces, or a row of controls that does not wrap. When those minimums add up to more than the grid's width, the grid scrolls horizontally instead of cutting content off. To fit a narrow screen, let wide cell content wrap (for example a FlareStack with Wrap for a row of action buttons) or give such columns a Width. Inherited from `FlareColumnBase`. |
